children: StableStock has officially launched Korean stock trading, enabling users to access more than 300 Korean-listed stocks and ETFs directly with stablecoins. The launch expands StableStock’s global equity coverage from the U.S. and Hong Kong into one of Asia’s most important capital markets.

At launch, StableStock supports Korean securities across major sectors including semiconductors, automobiles, internet platforms, biotechnology, and consumer industries. The initial lineup includes some of Korea’s most prominent publicly listed companies, including Samsung Electronics, SK hynix, Hyundai Motor, NAVER, and Kakao.

Korea plays a critical role in global technology and manufacturing supply chains, particularly across semiconductors, memory, automobiles, and advanced electronics. With global AI infrastructure investment continuing to grow, Korean companies such as Samsung Electronics and SK hynix have drawn increasing attention from investors seeking exposure to the global AI and semiconductor supply chain.

All Korean equities traded through StableStock correspond to real underlying shares, rather than synthetic assets or price-only exposure. Trades are executed through licensed financial institutions, with clearing and custody handled through regulated financial infrastructure.

Since officially launching more than a year ago, StableStock has served over 23,000 users and facilitated hundreds of millions of dollars in cumulative trading volume. The platform has continued to expand its market coverage as demand grows for stablecoin-based access to global equities.

Beyond expanding into new markets, StableStock is also building infrastructure connecting traditional equity markets with crypto-native trading strategies. The platform is opening its API infrastructure, allowing traders and institutions to use StableStock’s real-equity access as the spot leg for market-neutral and funding-rate strategies involving stock-linked derivatives.
StableStock also plans to introduce its own stock funding-rate strategy products, making these strategies more accessible without requiring users to independently manage both sides of the trade.
Looking ahead, StableStock plans to continue expanding into additional countries and equity markets, giving stablecoin users broader access to global stocks through a unified platform.
From U.S. and Hong Kong stocks to Korea and beyond, StableStock is building a broader bridge between stablecoin liquidity, real global equities, and crypto-native markets.

StableStock is a stablecoin-native global stock trading platform, enabling users worldwide to invest in real stocks and ETFs directly with stablecoins. Now supporting U.S., Hong Kong, and Korean markets, all trades are executed, settled, and custodied through licensed financial institutions. StableStock is backed by YZi Labs, MPCi (Matrix Partners China), and Vertex Ventures, and is expanding its coverage across global equity markets.

title: StableStock Expands to Korea, Bringing 300+ Korean Stocks and ETFs to Stablecoin Users
